name: HasPullback.of_createsLimit
statement: C ⥤ D) {X Y S : C} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) [CreatesLimit (cospan f g) F] [HasPullback (F.map f) (F.map g)] : HasPullback f g

name: HasPushout.of_createsColimit
statement: C ⥤ D) {X Y S : C} (f : S ⟶ X) (g : S ⟶ Y) [CreatesColimit (span f g) F] [HasPushout (F.map f) (F.map g)] : HasPushout f g
